thread:
jamie (sec-eng): heads-up — running a BYOK/HSM incident handoff simulation next Tue 10:00 PT. scenario: customer reports suspicious key usage (possible host compromise). want to validate RBAC rollback, audit ingestion, and KMS fallback procedures. who can own the run?
sofia (platform): I can own the orchestration. quick q: which customers' CMKs are in-scope? full BYOK or some are customer-managed via our KMS proxy?
jamie (sec-eng): scope = 2 large customers using customer-provided HSM keys via our BYOK proxy + 1 using imported CMK (cloud KMS). we need both HSM-escrow and cloud-kms flows exercised.
mike (infra): noted. I'll prepare the RBAC change script and a temporary restrict policy. plan: 1) apply emergency deny to service account used by the compromised host, 2) rotate proxy keys where possible, 3) enable read-only audit export to staging S3 bucket so sec can query.
tran (eng-sre): add me for the audit validation part. quick checks I'll run during sim:
```
# confirm recent writes to audit stream
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit-staging/2026/03/ || echo "no logs"
# grep for key-use events
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-staging/2026/03/14/log-0001.json - | jq '.events[] | select(.eventType=="KeyUsage")'
```
liz (privacy): ensure we don't export customer plaintext material to staging. only metadata + hashed identifiers. compliance requires a retention note for the sim artifacts.
jamie (sec-eng): yes — export schema = event_time, key_id (hashed:kid_sha256), action, source_ip, actor_id (hashed). no payload fields.
incident-bot: [SIM ALERT] simulated: anomalous export detected from proxy-host-17 -> marking P0 test alert.
sofia (platform): for KMS integration tests we should exercise rotation paths too. plan to trigger a rotation API on the imported CMK and verify clients failover to fallback variant. also need to verify metrics show increased latency when fallback is used.
mike (infra): RBAC change details: we will create a short-lived deny role and attach to the compromised SA. script snippet: 
```
gcloud iam roles create temp_deny_2140 --permissions="cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.use,cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get" --stage=ALPHA
# then bind deny to service account with deny condition
```
tran (eng-sre): I'll validate audit chain integrity using signature checks and make sure KV cache eviction events are recorded. If firmware vuln path is part of sim, we'll run the rollback to software-wrapped keys path and confirm decryption flow.
liz (privacy): also confirm we have audit retention proof for customers in scope — will need engagement from legal if we persist sim logs beyond 7 days.
jamie (sec-eng): action items: @sofia own orchestration, @mike RBAC and failover scripts, @tran audit queries + verification, @liz compliance signoff. please ack and add any missing steps. timeline: dry-run Fri, full sim Tue 10:00 PT.
sofia (platform): ack. will post runbook link and preflight checklist by EOD.
mike (infra): ack. prepping scripts in feature branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/byok-sims/tree/sim-2140
tran (eng-sre): ack. I'll build the jq queries and smoke tests and share them in the runbook channel.
liz (privacy): ack pending legal review — I'll ping legal for expedited sign-off.
jamie (sec-eng): perfect. last note: during sim, do not alter customer keys in-place — always exercise via copies or proxy toggles. failure domain must be reversible. :thumbsup:
